faq.title: The questions we get, answered straight.

free.a: Yes. Career memory, guard-rails, opportunities and anonymous outreach are free, with no time limit. The coach is included with a daily quota; Premium makes it unlimited and adds the negotiation agent.

employer.q: Can my current employer find me?
employer.a: No, not unless you decide so. Your profile is anonymous, your identity is encrypted in your browser, and you can exclude specific companies or entire sectors.

zeroKnowledge.a: Your identity is encrypted on your device before it’s sent. We keep a locked vault we don’t have the key to: not us, not a recruiter, not a hacker can read it without you.

approval.q: Can the agent write on my behalf without asking?
approval.a: No. It drafts, you approve. No message goes out without your explicit approval, and you choose when to lift anonymity, field by field.

ai.q: Which AI do you use, and where does my data go?
ai.a: Mistral AI models, hosted in the European Union. Only the data a task needs is shared with them, never your identity, and we don’t train any model on your data.

negotiation.a: You set a mandate: target salary, floor, conditions. The agent drafts counter-offers backed by a market salary benchmark, never going below your floor. You approve every message.

delete.q: Can I get all my data back, or delete it all?
delete.a: Yes, at any time, from your settings: a full export of your data, then permanent account deletion.

identity.intro: Your real identity, encrypted in your browser. It is kept apart from your professional profile, which is anonymised.

explain.title: No one, not even us, can read this data
explain.encrypted: Your name, contact details, employers, schools, links and original CV are encrypted in your browser before anything is sent. Our servers only receive and store an unreadable blob.
explain.nobody: Neither our team, nor our host, nor someone who stole our database can decrypt them: the key only exists on your side.
explain.you: Only you can unlock it, with your account password. It is never sent to or stored by our services: only a fingerprint that cannot open the vault is used to sign in.
explain.handover: Your identity is only revealed to a recruiter if you decide so, for that specific recruiter.
explain.loss: if you forget your password and lose your recovery key, this data is lost for good. We will not be able to recover it for you. Your professional profile is not affected.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Coach Career IA is a private career agent: privacy is the product. This page explains what data we process, why, for how long, with whom, and how to exercise your rights (General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR).

content.p1: {publisher} ({brand}), {address}. Contact for your data: {email}.

list.account: Account: email address, preferred language, creation and login dates, version of the terms accepted. No password: you sign in with a single-use link.
list.memory: Career Memory: experiences (job title, dates, level, employer described by its sector and size, never by name), achievements, skills, supporting documents (encrypted on our servers) and guard rails (salary, locations, remote work, contract types, excluded sectors and companies, the latter encrypted).
list.vault: Identity vault: your name, contact details, the real names of your employers and your original CV are encrypted in your browser with a key derived from your passphrase. The server only stores encrypted data that it cannot read; neither the passphrase nor the key is ever sent to it.
list.import: Imports: the CV, LinkedIn export or public GitHub profile you import are analysed to offer you a draft Career Memory, which you review and validate before anything is saved.
list.coach: AI coach: your conversations with the coach and the suggestions it makes to you.
list.matching: Opportunities and alerts: the job postings selected for you, their score and explanation, your reactions; email alerts are only sent if you turn them on, and every email contains an unsubscribe link.
list.contacts: Anonymous card, outreach and negotiation: your anonymous card, the messages sent to companies after your approval, the contact address of the person you specify, the replies received and your negotiation mandate (encrypted).
list.handover: Identity reveal: only the fields you choose to reveal to a company, accessible through a revocable link that expires after {handoverDays} days.
list.billing: Subscription: plan taken, subscription status and renewal date, payment provider identifiers. We never see or store your card number.
list.company: Company accounts: the member’s professional email address, the organisation’s name, website, sector, size and country, published job postings and related payments.
list.logs: Technical logs: technical identifiers, counters and errors, with no personal content (no email, no name, no text you entered).

list.contract: Performance of a contract (article 6.1.b GDPR): account, Career Memory, vault, imports, coach, opportunities, outreach and identity reveals that you request, subscription, company workspace.
list.consent: Consent (article 6.1.a): email alerts, which you can withdraw at any time from the settings or the unsubscribe link.
list.interest: Legitimate interest (article 6.1.f): security of the service, abuse prevention, moderation of job postings and organisations, technical logs.
list.obligation: Legal obligation (article 6.1.c): retention of accounting records relating to payments.

list.account: Account, Career Memory, vault and coach data: for as long as the account exists. Deleting the account immediately erases all this data and all your files; backup copies disappear within 30 days at most.
list.auth: Login link: 15 minutes, single use. Login session: 30 days, revoked when you sign out.
list.card: Anonymous card links: {cardDays} days. Data revealed in an identity reveal: {handoverDays} days, then automatically purged.
list.postings: Company job postings: published for {postingDays} days then closed; kept for as long as the organisation exists.
list.accounting: Accounting records relating to payments: 10 years (article L123-22 of the French Commercial Code).

content.p1: Your data is never sold or rented. A company only receives what you have approved: a message, your anonymous card, or the fields you choose to reveal. Our processors act only on our instructions:

list.mistral: Mistral AI (France, hosted in the European Union): language model used for imports, the coach, opportunity explanations and message drafts. We do not train any model with your data.
list.email: Email delivery ({emailProvider}): login links, alerts and messages to companies.
list.host: Hosting ({hostName}): virtual private server located in the European Union, which hosts the application and the database.
list.payment: Payment: {payments, select, stripe {Stripe Payments Europe (Ireland) processes card payments; it only receives your login email address and an account identifier, never your Career Memory or your identity.} other {payments are simulated during the test phase: no payment data is collected. When payments open, Stripe Payments Europe (Ireland) will process them.}}
list.geo: Geocoding: city names (never your identity) are sent to the IGN Géoplateforme (France) and to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to calculate distances.
list.github: GitHub: only if you import a GitHub profile, to read its public information.

content.p1: Data is hosted and processed in the European Union. We do not transfer your data outside the European Union; if a provider were to do so, it would only be with the safeguards provided for by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses of the European Commission).

Passwordless login, revocable sessions, AES-256 encryption of sensitive fields and supporting documents, identity vault end-to-end encrypted in your browser, data access limited to your account, logs free of personal data.

You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, the right to withdraw your consent, and the right to give directions on what happens to your data after your death.

list.edit: Correct your information directly in your workspace (Career Memory, guard rails, identity).
list.contact: For any other request: {email}. We reply within one month.

content.p2: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the <cnil>CNIL</cnil> (the French data protection authority, Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés).

ai.title: How our AI works
ai.intro: Coach Career IA uses a language model to save you time, never to decide for you. This page meets the transparency obligation of the EU AI Act (article 50) and of the GDPR.

list.import: Turn your CV or imported profile into a draft Career Memory, which you validate.
list.coach: Ask you questions to bring out your achievements and their evidence (AI coach).
list.matching: Explain in a few sentences why a job posting matches your conditions.
list.drafts: Write drafts of outreach messages and negotiation counter-proposals, within the mandate you have set.

list.send: It never sends anything without your explicit approval, message by message.
list.reveal: It never reveals your identity: only your decision, field by field, allows it.
list.rank: It does not assess or rank candidates for companies: no company sees a list or score of candidates.
list.decide: It makes no decision that produces legal effects concerning you: no automated decision within the meaning of article 22 GDPR.
list.train: It is not trained with your data: we do not train any model.

content.p1: Each draft is shown to you before anything is sent: you can edit it, reject it or send it. Your guard rails are your own rules, applied as they are; an opportunity’s score is only used to order the postings offered to you, and you remain free to view all of them.
Every message sent to a company states that it was prepared by an AI agent on behalf of a candidate, who reviewed and approved it.
We use models from Mistral AI, a French company, hosted in the European Union. Only the data needed for the requested task is passed to them; your identity, encrypted in your vault, never is.
A language model can make mistakes or word information poorly. Always review a draft before approving it. To report a problem: {email}.
